title: 保留进度的图解教程
prompt: “教我组装书架，每步配图，能勾选，追问时保留进度。”
program:
root = Col([intro, tool, celebration])
$step = 0
$done = []
intro = Col([Title("组装一个四层书架", "xl"), Text("按顺序完成每一步，完成后打勾；点击下方缩略图可跳到对应步骤。示例步骤按常见的四层书架绘制，请以包装内清单和说明书为准。", "md", "muted")], 2)
tool = Card([head, viewer, strip, Divider(), checklist, Divider(), actions], null, 4, 4)
head = Row([Badge("步骤 " + ($step + 1) + " / " + @Count(steps), "info"), Spacer(), Caption(@Count($done) + " / " + @Count(steps) + " 步完成"), IconButton("rotate-ccw", @Reset($done, $step), "清空进度", "ghost")], 2)
viewer = Col([Box([drawings[$step]], null, null, 3, "surface", "lg"), Title(steps[$step].title, "md"), Text(steps[$step].text, "sm")], 3)
strip = Grid(@Each(@Range(0, @Count(steps)), "i", Pressable([drawings[i], Caption((i + 1) + ". " + steps[i].title)], @Set($step, i), i == $step, 2)), 4, 96, 2)
checklist = Col([Label("完成清单"), Col(checklistItems, 1)], 2)
checklistItems = @Each(steps, "s", Pressable([Row([Icon(@Includes($done, s.id) ? "check-circle" : "circle", "sm"), Text("步骤 " + (s.id + 1) + " · " + s.title, "sm", null, null, false, @Includes($done, s.id))], 2)], @Set($done, @Toggle($done, s.id)), @Includes($done, s.id), 2))
actions = Row([Button("上一步", @Set($step, @Clamp($step - 1, 0, @Count(steps) - 1)), "outline", null, null, "arrow-left", $step == 0), Spacer(), Button("下一步", @Set($step, @Clamp($step + 1, 0, @Count(steps) - 1)), "solid", null, null, "arrow-right", $step == @Count(steps) - 1)], 2)
celebration = Celebration(@Count($done) == @Count(steps))
steps = [{id: 0, title: "清点板材与配件", text: "两块侧板、顶板、底板、一块隔板、背板，以及对应数量的木榫和偏心轮。把木榫敲入两侧侧板的孔位。"}, {id: 1, title: "固定板材到一侧", text: "将顶板、底板和隔板依次对准一侧侧板的木榫插入，并用螺丝刀顺时针锁紧每个偏心轮。"}, {id: 2, title: "安装另一侧侧板", text: "把另一侧侧板对准露出的木榫压紧，再逐个锁紧偏心轮，确认框架方正。"}, {id: 3, title: "钉上背板", text: "将背板覆盖在框架背面，检查对角线等长后，沿四边每隔约 10 厘米钉入小钉固定。"}]
drawings = [s0, s1, s2, s3]
s0 = Svg([Rect(16, 22, 24, 116, "surface", "ink", 2), Rect(200, 22, 24, 116, "surface", "ink", 2), Rect(40, 16, 160, 14, "surface", "ink", 2), Rect(40, 64, 160, 14, "surface", "ink", 2), Rect(40, 112, 160, 14, "surface", "ink", 2), Rect(74, 138, 92, 12, "#EFE9DF", "ink", 2), Circle(52, 44, 3, "chart1"), Circle(52, 88, 3, "chart1"), Circle(52, 132, 3, "chart1"), SvgText("侧板 ×2", 52, 154, 11, "muted", "middle"), SvgText("顶板", 120, 12, 11, "muted", "middle"), SvgText("底板", 120, 60, 11, "muted", "middle"), SvgText("背板", 120, 146, 11, "muted", "middle")], "0 0 240 160")
s1 = Svg([Rect(40, 20, 18, 124, "surface", "ink", 2), Rect(56, 20, 148, 14, "surface", "ink", 2), Rect(56, 74, 148, 14, "surface", "ink", 2), Rect(56, 130, 148, 14, "surface", "ink", 2), Circle(74, 27, 4, "info"), Circle(74, 81, 4, "info"), Circle(74, 137, 4, "info"), SvgText("偏心轮", 40, 104, 11, "info"), Line(216, 81, 202, 81, "info", 2), Polygon("202,76 202,86 194,81", "info")], "0 0 240 160")
s2 = Svg([Rect(40, 20, 18, 124, "surface", "ink", 2), Rect(56, 20, 148, 14, "surface", "ink", 2), Rect(56, 74, 148, 14, "surface", "ink", 2), Rect(56, 130, 148, 14, "surface", "ink", 2), Rect(202, 20, 18, 124, "surface", "info", 2), Line(236, 82, 222, 82, "info", 2), Polygon("218,77 218,87 210,82", "info"), Circle(74, 27, 4, "info"), Circle(74, 81, 4, "info"), Circle(74, 137, 4, "info"), SvgText("已锁紧", 120, 124, 11, "info")], "0 0 240 160")
s3 = Svg([Rect(40, 20, 160, 124, "#EFE9DF", "ink", 2), Circle(52, 37, 2.5, "ink"), Circle(92, 37, 2.5, "ink"), Circle(132, 37, 2.5, "ink"), Circle(172, 37, 2.5, "ink"), Circle(52, 79, 2.5, "ink"), Circle(172, 79, 2.5, "ink"), Circle(52, 121, 2.5, "ink"), Circle(172, 121, 2.5, "ink"), Line(228, 82, 212, 82, "warning", 2), Polygon("208,77 208,87 200,82", "warning"), SvgText("背板", 120, 42, 11, "muted", "middle"), SvgText("小钉", 214, 76, 11, "warning", "middle")], "0 0 240 160")
